name: Reliance Industries Ltd
about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

flags.text: Operating cash ≥ reported profit over 5 years (1.90x) — earnings are real.

docs.label: Nov 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlighted record all-time high PAT/EBITDA, successful listing of Jio, and strong structural market positioning.

guidance.statement: Tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores for first half performance in O2C
guidance.quote: it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores

guidance.statement: New energy earnings contribution definitely starting in FY28
guidance.quote: earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028

guidance.statement: Retail online investments expected to deliver absolute EBITDA results and accretion next year
guidance.quote: we are quite confident these will start giving us results next year where they will start being accretive to the bottom line as well.

guidance.statement: Module capacity expanding to 20 GW early next year; cell capacity expanding to 20 GW in H1 next year
guidance.quote: we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year. Similarly, solar cell is now nearing around 5-gigawatt and we will be achieving again 20-gigawatt capacity sometime first half next year.

guidance.statement: Commissioning BESS facility up to 40 GWh in next half year and battery cell 35-40 GWh late next year
guidance.quote: In next half year we will commission our BESS facility, which is a pack and container up to 40-gigawatt hour and cell will come sometime I would say late next year, which is again around 35-gigawatt to 40-gigawatt hour.

pushback.concern: Online grocery growth at 42% appears underwhelming compared to quick commerce competitors.

achieved.claim: Consolidated quarterly EBITDA reached record high Rs. 62,409 Crores, up 24% YoY.
Consolidated PAT crossed Rs. 50,000 Crores mark, up 34% YoY to near Rs. 30,000 Crores.
Jio total subscriber base reached 542 million with 300 million 5G customers.
Retail online B2C grocery revenue grew 42% YoY.

docs.label: Jul 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlighted extraordinary operational performance despite macro volatility, strong EBITDA growth, and ambitious long-term targets.

guidance.statement: Targeting to double absolute EBITDA over the coming years via disciplined digital retail scale.
guidance.quote: what we are saying is we are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number.

guidance.statement: FMCG business targeting revenue of Rs.1 lakh Crores by FY2030.
guidance.quote: we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.

guidance.statement: Will continue expanding dark store network over the next 9 to 12 months.
guidance.quote: we will continue our expansion of our dark store network. At least next 12 months, I think in the next nine to 10 months it will continue.

guidance.statement: Peak solar PV installation target of 55 MWp per day and battery installation target of 150 MWh per day.
guidance.quote: We continue to keep preparing for execution at scale, which we have announced at 55 MWp of solar PV per day and 150 MWh of battery installations per day

guidance.statement: KGD6 ceiling gas price expected to trend upwards to around $9.9 in H2.
guidance.quote: we expect this to trend upwards and go towards $9.9 in the second half.

pushback.concern: Digital services 20% growth coming off a low base relative to connectivity growth run-rates.
Retail EBITDA margin pressure from digital and quick commerce expansion investments.
Request for details on overall full-year capex plan and directional allocation.

achieved.claim: Consolidated topline grew 25% YoY; EBITDA exceeded Rs.54,000 Crores, up 10%.
Jio Platforms operating revenues reached Rs.39,173 Crores, up 12% YoY.
Reliance Retail delivered Rs.90,000 Crores topline with 11.6% underlying YoY revenue growth.
FMCG business delivered Rs.8,600 Crores revenue, doubling compared to last year.

docs.label: Apr 2026
docs.tone_why: Management highlights record revenues and milestones despite significant geopolitical headwinds and supply shocks.

guidance.statement: Management expects to increase acquisition rate for home connections using AirFiber technology at scale.
guidance.quote: this now further expands the addressable market... will help us increase the run rate, increase the acquisition rate even more.

guidance.statement: Targeting near 100% of home installations to occur within 24 hours of request.
guidance.quote: over 90% of the installations are happening within 24 hours, of course we will strive will target to take this closer to 100%

guidance.statement: Expectation for per capita data consumption to continue healthy growth driven by AI and media use cases.
guidance.quote: Per capita data consumption... continues to see very healthy growth, and we are expecting this to keep growing like this

guidance.statement: Anticipate fuel cracks to remain strong due to refinery damage and Red Sea navigation concerns.
guidance.quote: We think cracks may remain strong for some time to come with damage to refinery as well as all these concerns

guidance.statement: Expect lower global refining and production capacities due to current geopolitical situations.
guidance.quote: forward we expect to see lower capacities on production as well as on refining both

guidance.statement: Anticipate customs duty exemptions on petrochemicals to be revoked as prices moderate.
guidance.quote: since the prices are slightly getting moderated from the peaks... this is likely to get revoked in the second quarter

guidance.statement: Expectation of a 12% to 14% decline in production, currently managed at 8%.
guidance.quote: We had expected about 12% to 14% decline as against that we are getting about... 8% decline.

guidance.statement: Qatar gas capacity impact expected to take five years to recover.
guidance.quote: Qataris are mentioning, that it may take them almost five years to bring that back.

pushback.concern: Retail EBITDA margins are being diluted by rapid growth in low-margin quick commerce and hyperlocal deliveries.
Query regarding the timeline for Jio's IPO previously stated for first half of 2026.
Impact of under-recoveries in fuel retailing due to frozen domestic prices despite high crude costs.
Low square footage growth in retail suggesting a shift from physical expansion to consolidation.

achieved.claim: Reached milestone of 20,000 retail stores during the quarter.
Jio crossed 30,000 Crores in annual Profit After Tax.
Achieved 10 million net home subscriber additions during the last 12 months.
Retail business delivered highest ever quarterly revenue of Rs. 98,000 Crores.

docs.label: Jan 2026
docs.tone_why: Management strongly defended business scale, market share gains, and long-term double-digit growth prospects.

guidance.statement: Retail business will aggregate and continue to deliver double-digit revenue growth.
guidance.quote: Aggregate basis will continue to deliver double-digit revenues.

guidance.statement: Organically expects Jio ARPU to improve by 5% to 6% per year.
guidance.quote: Organically, if we can improve our ARPU by 5% to 6% a year, I think that is a good number

guidance.statement: FMCG business will more than double its beverage capacity during the year.
guidance.quote: We will be more than doubling our capacity on beverages this year.

guidance.statement: Petrochemical industry demand-supply balance restoration expected in about a year.
guidance.quote: It might take about a year or so to come back to that level, but that should bring back the normalcy

pushback.concern: Low sequential ARPU growth despite strong subscriber and 5G uptake.
Slowing retail revenue growth in Q3 and impact of RCPL demerger.
Uncertainty around capex spend breakdown and future funding for new energy business.

achieved.claim: Digital services revenues crossed 37,000 Crores with 52% EBITDA margin.
Retail recorded highest ever revenue at 97,600 Crores, up 8.1% year-on-year.
FMCG turnover reached over 5,000 Crores, up 60% year-on-year.
O2C EBITDA grew 15% year-on-year driven by strong transportation fuel deltas.

ar.what_they_do: Reliance Industries operates diversified businesses spanning oil-to-chemicals, oil and gas exploration, retail, and digital services across India and internationally.
drivers: Network expansion, improved category mix, private label contribution, and operating efficiencies in retail.
Stronger transportation fuel cracks, efficient feedstock sourcing, and higher domestic product placement in O2C.
Rapid broadband proliferation and live sports driving digital adoption and connected TV growth.

watch.text: Revenue recognition at step-down subsidiary RJIL identified as key audit matter due to high data volumes and complex IT systems.
IT systems and controls over financial reporting identified as key audit matter due to transaction volumes and cyber security.

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Reliance shows strong operational execution in O2C and Jio, but retail margins face pressure from quick commerce investments while management remains evasive on specific capex and IPO timelines.

promises.promise: FMCG business targeting revenue of Rs. 1 lakh Crores by FY2030.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show FMCG revenue reached Rs. 8,600 Crores in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Revenue doubled year-on-year, showing strong early momentum toward the long-term target.

promises.promise: Module capacity expanding to 20 GW early next year; cell capacity to 20 GW in H1.
promises.actual: Current solar cell capacity is nearing 5 GW.
promises.why: Target horizon is FY28; current capacity is a fraction of the goal.

promises.promise: Organically improve Jio ARPU by 5% to 6% per year.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q2 FY27 revenue grew 29.8% YoY, suggesting ARPU/subscriber gains.
promises.why: Strong revenue growth and 5G uptake support ARPU expansion goals.

promises.promise: Retail business will continue to deliver double-digit revenue growth.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q1 FY27 underlying revenue growth was 11.6%.
promises.why: Management maintained double-digit growth despite slowing Q3 FY26 trends.

promises.promise: Commissioning BESS facility up to 40 GWh in next half year.
promises.actual: Facility commissioning expected in the coming six months.
promises.why: The target date has not yet been reached.

promises.promise: Targeting near 100% of home installations within 24 hours.
promises.actual: Management reported over 90% of installations currently happen within 24 hours.
promises.why: Current performance is close to the stated 100% efficiency goal.

promises.promise: Jio IPO previously stated for first half of 2026.
promises.actual: Management gave an evasive answer when questioned on the timeline.
promises.why: Management avoided confirming the previously stated H1 2026 timeline.

credibility.line: Management consistently hits operational milestones but remains evasive on capital allocation details and specific timelines for major corporate actions like IPOs.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims record quarterly EBITDA and PAT performance.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q2 FY27 PAT grew 33.8% to Rs. 29,550 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Retail business is delivering double-digit revenue growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q3 FY26 revenue growth slowed to 8.1%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Operating margins are resilient despite macro volatility.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show OPM dropped from 18% to 15% in Q4 FY26.

bull.point: Strong cash flow quality supports massive capital expenditure.
bull.evidence: CFO to PAT ratio is 1.90x over 5 years.

bull.point: Rapid 5G adoption and subscriber growth in digital services.
Aggressive expansion in New Energy segment nearing commissioning.
bull.evidence: 20 GW solar capacity expected in H1 FY28.

bear.point: Retail margins are under pressure from digital investments.
bear.evidence: Management admitted margin pressure from quick commerce.

bear.point: Lack of transparency regarding total capex and funding.
bear.evidence: Management was evasive on capex breakdown.

bear.point: O2C segment remains vulnerable to geopolitical and price volatility.
bear.evidence: OPM fell to 15% in Q4 FY26.

watch_next: New Energy earnings contribution starting in FY28.
Jio IPO timeline clarity in upcoming quarters.
Retail margin recovery following quick commerce scale-up.
